apps.name: Nuvio
apps.subtitle: A free, open-source media app for your phone, your desktop, and the TV you already own.
apps.localizedDescription:
A free, open-source media app for your phone, your desktop, and the TV you already own.

Bring your own sources. Nuvio turns them into a library with artwork, ratings, subtitles, and your place saved on every screen.

versions.localizedDescription:
# Nuvio 1.0.0

Thank you to everyone who has contributed to the project, tested the betas, and supported us along the way.

> [!NOTE]
> On Android, choose **Stable** in **Settings → About → Update channel** for fewer updates and a more stable build. Choose **Beta** for frequent updates, with possible breaking changes. If you were already on a beta build, you stay on **Beta** until you switch.

- [i18n: add French strings and align birth and death wording (#2664)](https://github.com/NuvioMedia/NuvioMobile/pull/2664) @SK-Gits  
- [i18n(vi): update latest Vietnamese strings (#2622)](https://github.com/NuvioMedia/NuvioMobile/pull/2622) @blueocean2308  
- [perf: smoother cold start and home on Android (#2652)](https://github.com/NuvioMedia/NuvioMobile/pull/2652) @skoruppa  
- [fix(home): show hero only after its source catalogs load (#2651)](https://github.com/NuvioMedia/NuvioMobile/pull/2651) @skoruppa  
- [feat(player): basic keyboard support (#2633)](https://github.com/NuvioMedia/NuvioMobile/pull/2633) @skoruppa  
- [fix(cw): dismiss a next up show by its content id, as on TV (#2632)](https://github.com/NuvioMedia/NuvioMobile/pull/2632) @skoruppa  
- [feat(cw): choose what selecting a Continue Watching item opens (#2630)](https://github.com/NuvioMedia/NuvioMobile/pull/2630) @skoruppa  
- [Translation improvements and adjustments for Slovak language (#2625)](https://github.com/NuvioMedia/NuvioMobile/pull/2625) @mmsw91  
- [i18n: add French strings for chapter title setting (#2621)](https://github.com/NuvioMedia/NuvioMobile/pull/2621) @SK-Gits  
- [feat(player): fall back to the next matching source on failure (#2612)](https://github.com/NuvioMedia/NuvioMobile/pull/2612) @skoruppa  
- [fix(player): show each start-up step on the loading screen, like NuvioTV (#2611)](https://github.com/NuvioMedia/NuvioMobile/pull/2611) @skoruppa

- [feat(player): chapters setting for every engine, chapters on iOS and a chapter title toggle (#2609)](https://github.com/NuvioMedia/NuvioMobile/pull/2609) @skoruppa  
- [fix(collections): respect "Show catalog type" in folders (#2608)](https://github.com/NuvioMedia/NuvioMobile/pull/2608) @skoruppa  
- [fix(player): show the real cause of playback errors, like NuvioTV (#2607)](https://github.com/NuvioMedia/NuvioMobile/pull/2607) @skoruppa  
- [fix(player): use the audio clock when mpv video time drops to 0 (#2605)](https://github.com/NuvioMedia/NuvioMobile/pull/2605) @skoruppa  
- [fix(player): add an SPS/PPS init segment to HLS streams that lack them (#2606)](https://github.com/NuvioMedia/NuvioMobile/pull/2606) @skoruppa  
- [fix(player): decode DASH MIME query hints before detection (#2600)](https://github.com/NuvioMedia/NuvioMobile/pull/2600) @retrocodes12  
- [i18n(vi): update latest Vietnamese strings (#2601)](https://github.com/NuvioMedia/NuvioMobile/pull/2601) @blueocean2308  
- [fix(streams): keep tokenized links for reuse and refresh expired saved links (#2598)](https://github.com/NuvioMedia/NuvioMobile/pull/2598) @skoruppa  
- [i18n: add French string for signed-out notice (#2593)](https://github.com/NuvioMedia/NuvioMobile/pull/2593) @SK-Gits  
- [Update Dutch (nl) strings and reorder Dutch in Settings (#2592)](https://github.com/NuvioMedia/NuvioMobile/pull/2592) @mronion212

apps.name: YTKACE
apps.subtitle: YouTube enhancer and downloader for iOS
apps.localizedDescription: YTKACE is a free, open-source YouTube enhancer and downloader for iOS with SponsorBlock, background playback, player controls, and interface customization including liquid glass.

versions.localizedDescription:
by @itzzace0

The FlareStore certificate giveaway is still going in the YTKACE Telegram channel: https://t.me/ytkace

What's new:
• Updated to YouTube 21.46.3
• Added Return YouTube Dislike for videos, Shorts and the description panel
• YTKACE and YouTube buttons can now be mixed in the top row and the fullscreen bar
• Added a left button column, and every player button can now be edited in the layout editor
• Added fullscreen bar button toggles
• Added a compact Quality Button and quality settings for AirPlay and Low Power Mode
• Added an option to bypass the Premium device streaming limit
• Added Shorts feed filters for live streams and posts
• Shorts auto-scroll now waits while you read comments
• Reworked Swipe to Seek and hold speed
• PiP now uses native iOS PiP

Fixed:
• Crash when the fullscreen buttons rebuild
• PiP not starting again after a Short or after the first time
• PiP starting when leaving the app with the video paused
• Player download button with HLS
• Captions turning back on after turning them off
• Shorts missing on channels opened from a Short
• Tab bar taps when the Shorts tab is hidden
• Glass tab bar hidden behind incognito and the sleep timer strip
• Controls hiding while using buttons, hold speed seeking, backup restore and title overlap

YouTube 21.46.3 requires iOS 17, so there are two IPAs:
• `YTKACE_1.1.8_YouTube_21.46.3.ipa` for iOS 17 and newer
• `YTKACE_1.1.8_YouTube_iOS16_21.33.6.ipa` for iOS 16

by @itzzace0

1,000 stars 🎉
Thanks for 1k stars! To celebrate, [FlareStore](https://flarestore.vip/p/ytkace) is sponsoring a giveaway of 5 certificates in the new YTKACE Telegram channel: https://t.me/ytkace

What's new:
• Updated to YouTube 21.45.4
• Button Layout: drag the player buttons into YouTube's top row, the row under it, or next to the fullscreen button
• Added a Quality Button that shows the current quality
• Added Auto Fullscreen and Exit Fullscreen at End
• Added Swipe to Seek
• Added Previous/Next Skip
• Added Keep Playing, which stops the "Continue watching?" pause
• Added a Playlist tab
• Added a default video quality and audio language for downloads
• Added Remove Live Videos from Home
• Added an Auto-Scroll Delay for Shorts
• Added a minimum segment length to SponsorBlock
• Added iPhone Duo layouts

Fixed:
• Videos missing from Home on some accounts
• Lock screen scrubbing and skip not working for downloads
• Tabs not switching when Home is hidden
• Live streams counted as finished in the queue
• Auto-scroll skipping Shorts before they end
• Show Status Bar in Fullscreen not working
• Invisible back button with OLED in light mode
• HLS Streams not falling back when a video fails
• Tab icons and labels on vertical tab bars

YouTube 21.45.4 requires iOS 17, so there are two IPAs:
• `YTKACE_1.1.7_YouTube_21.45.4.ipa` for iOS 17 and newer
• `YTKACE_1.1.7_YouTube_iOS16_21.33.6.ipa` for iOS 16

by @itzzace0

What's new:
• Updated to YouTube 21.44.4
• Normal Home Layout now brings back the old Home with topic chips
• Added Turn Off Haptics
• Added Open Links Directly
• Added Remove Autoplay Prompt
• Added Remove More Videos
• Added an option to remove Listen with YouTube Music from the ⋯ menu
• Added a rotate button to the downloads player
• Captions can now be turned on in Always Off mode

Fixed:
• Tab settings ignored on YouTube's glass tab bar
• Glass tab bar with icon-only tabs
• Startup tab when Home is hidden
• Tab labels and icons on YouTube's icon-only tab bar
• Subscriptions tab missing from the bottom bar, and its icon
• Remove Channel Watermark not working
• Remove End Screen not working
• Keep Progress Bar Visible not working

YouTube 21.44.4 requires iOS 17, so there are two IPAs:
• `YTKACE_1.1.5_YouTube_21.44.4.ipa` for iOS 17 and newer
• `YTKACE_1.1.5_YouTube_iOS16_21.33.6.ipa` for iOS 16
